module mg_05051 (clk,incr_addr,reset_n,new_rom,num_bytes,q,safe);
parameter POLL_RATE = 100; 
  output new_rom; 
  output [ 31: 0] num_bytes; 
  output [ 7: 0] q; 
  output safe; 
  input clk; 
  input incr_addr; 
  input reset_n; 
  reg [ 11: 0] address; 
  reg d1_pre; 
  reg d2_pre; 
  reg d3_pre; 
  reg d4_pre; 
  reg d5_pre; 
  reg d6_pre; 
  reg d7_pre; 
  reg d8_pre; 
  reg d9_pre; 
  reg [ 7: 0] mem_array [2047: 0]; 
  reg [ 31: 0] mutex [ 1: 0]; 
  reg new_rom; 
  wire [ 31: 0] num_bytes; 
  reg pre; 
  wire [ 7: 0] q; 
  wire safe; 
  assign q = mem_array[address]; 
  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) 
  begin 
  if (reset_n == 0) 
  begin 
  d1_pre <= 0; 
  d2_pre <= 0; 
  d3_pre <= 0; 
  d4_pre <= 0; 
  d5_pre <= 0; 
  d6_pre <= 0; 
  d7_pre <= 0; 
  d8_pre <= 0; 
  d9_pre <= 0; 
  new_rom <= 0; 
  end 
  else 
  begin 
  d1_pre <= pre; 
  d2_pre <= d1_pre; 
  d3_pre <= d2_pre; 
  d4_pre <= d3_pre; 
  d5_pre <= d4_pre; 
  d6_pre <= d5_pre; 
  d7_pre <= d6_pre; 
  d8_pre <= d7_pre; 
  d9_pre <= d8_pre; 
  new_rom <= d9_pre; 
  end 
  end 
  assign num_bytes = mutex[1]; 
  reg safe_delay; 
  reg [31:0] poll_count; 
  reg [31:0] mutex_handle; 
  wire interactive = 1'b0 ; 
  assign safe = (address < mutex[1]); 
  initial poll_count = POLL_RATE; 
  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin 
  if (reset_n !== 1) begin 
  safe_delay <= 0; 
  end else begin 
  safe_delay <= safe; 
  end 
  end 
  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin 
  if (reset_n !== 1) begin 
  address <= 0; 
  mem_array[0] <= 0; 
  mutex[0] <= 0; 
  mutex[1] <= 0; 
  pre <= 0; 
  end else begin 
  pre <= 0; 
  if (incr_addr && safe) address <= address + 1; 
  if (mutex[0] && !safe && safe_delay) begin 
  if (interactive) begin 
  mutex_handle = $fopen ("jtag_uart_0_input_mutex.dat"); 
  $fdisplay (mutex_handle, "0"); 
  $fclose (mutex_handle); 
  end else begin 
  wait (!reset_n); 
  end 
  end 
  if (poll_count < POLL_RATE) begin 
  poll_count = poll_count + 1; 
  end else begin 
  poll_count = 0; 
  if (mutex_handle) begin 
  $readmemh ("jtag_uart_0_input_mutex.dat", mutex); 
  end 
  if (mutex[0] && !safe) begin 
  mutex[1] <= mutex[0]; 
  $readmemb("jtag_uart_0_input_stream.dat", mem_array); 
  address <= 0; 
  pre <= -1; 
  end 
  end 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
